outcome: High utilization of emergency department (3 or more visits within 90 days)
cohort: 1,071,232 women with live births in California from 2009 to 2011
finding: Medicaid insurance, younger age, severe maternal morbidity at delivery, antepartum complications, and cesarean delivery were identified as significant risk factors for postpartum emergency department visits within 90 days of delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of postpartum emergency department visit (adjusted OR 1.40, 95% CI 1.37-1.44).
